response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer with genuine passion for developer tooling (test runner and assertion libraries for D, MCP code generators, a stint on the LabWindows/CVI C IDE at National Instruments), but the resume shows almost no evidence of the role's core hard requirements: Java appears only peripherally in two roles from 2016–2018, Kotlin and Spring are entirely absent, and there is no indication of deep JVM knowledge, enterprise frameworks (Quarkus, Hibernate), JVM build tools, or application server integration. The last decade of work is predominantly TypeScript/Node.js and DLang. The tooling instincts and large-scale systems experience are real positives, but the JVM/enterprise-framework gap is too central to this position to bridge in a mid-senior IC hire.
strengths: Demonstrated passion for developer tooling: built a D test runner, assertion library, and worked on a commercial C IDE
Broad, deep engineering experience across low-latency services, distributed systems, and full-stack product work
Strong craftsmanship signals — TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, teaching, conference talks, open-source ownership
concerns: No Kotlin and no Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate experience anywhere in the resume
Java experience is minimal and dated (2016–2018); no evidence of deep JVM internals knowledge
No exposure to JVM build tools or application server integration, the role's primary focus areas
